benefits.name: Brilliant Dining Credit
benefits.description: Monthly statement credit for eligible purchases at restaurants worldwide.
benefits.terms: Up to $25/month ($300/year total). Unused monthly amounts do not roll over.

benefits.name: Ritz-Carlton / St. Regis Property Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for qualifying charges at The Ritz-Carlton or St. Regis when booking direct with a special rate for a minimum two-night stay.
benefits.terms: Requires direct booking of a qualifying rate with a minimum 2-night stay.

benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite status, including a 50% points bonus on eligible hotel purchases and 25 Elite Night Credits toward higher status each calendar year.
benefits.terms: Automatic for cardholders by linking a Marriott Bonvoy account. 25 Elite Night Credits awarded each calendar year toward the next elite tier.

benefits.name: Annual Free Night Award
benefits.description: Free Night Award granted every year after card renewal month, usable at a Marriott Bonvoy hotel with a redemption level at or under 85,000 points. An additional 'Brilliant Earned Choice Award' is granted after $60,000 in calendar-year spending.
benefits.terms: Awarded automatically each year after card renewal, no spend requirement. Separate 'Brilliant Earned Choice Award' requires $60,000 in eligible purchases in a calendar year.

benefits.name: Priority Pass Select Membership
benefits.description: Complimentary Priority Pass Select membership with unlimited visits to over 1,300 participating airport lounges for the cardholder and up to two guests.

loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Cardholder plus up to two guests admitted at no charge.

benefits.name: Global Entry or TSA PreCheck Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for a Global Entry (every 4 years) or TSA PreCheck application fee.
benefits.terms: Global Entry credit is up to $120; TSA PreCheck credit is up to $85. Modeled here on the Global Entry cadence.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement for prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses when a covered trip is cancelled or interrupted.

earningRates.terms: Card-earned rate at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy; combines with base Marriott Bonvoy membership and Platinum Elite bonus points for up to 21x total.
Restaurants worldwide and flights booked directly with airlines.
